page.overview:
Who is Ultima?

Ultima (60px), also known as Altima, is the leader of the Lucavi demons in Final Fantasy Tactics, being the game's final boss. She is given the title the "Angel of Blood" and is associated with the Virgo auracite.

Ultima was the most powerful and ancient of the Lucavi, a supernatural demonic race originating from another dimension connected to the world of Ivalice. At some point during the predominant period of the Holy Ydoran Empire and its religion, Ultima possessed a man named Ajora Glabados (founder of the future Church of Glabados), although the circumstances of how this occurred are unknown. Through her vessel, Ultima made him a miraculous preacher of sanctified origin and supposedly created the Zodiac Stones with the goal of uniting her companions through auracites and sowing chaos in Ivalice. She was prevented from achieving her goal due to the capture and execution of Ajora at the hands of his traitorous disciple, Germonique.

With Ajora's death, Ultima ended up trapped in his body, preventing her from possessing another mortal through her auracite. According to legend, upon Ajora's execution a catastrophe of apocalyptic proportions (later named the cataclysm) sank Mullonde (the center of Ydoran religion) into the sea, also causing a series of disasters that devastated several Ivalician kingdoms and decimated countless lives, including entire non-human races.

1200 years after Ultima's imprisonment, the twelve auracites that Ajora and his disciples were said to have wielded as the Zodiac Braves have been scattered throughout Ivalice, which was once again at war, this time between two duchies vying for the throne and control of the kingdom. Because the Church of Glabados had distorted the true story of Ajora's life to conceal his true nature, his devotees were unaware of the Stones' ability to possess their bearers.
